scope: New AVA source-disjoint evaluation protocol; full validation only after execution
sampling: Earliest eligible four-second track per speaking/listener/transition category; fixed native-resolution/alignment checks may exclude at decode time; never replace based on model outcomes

degradation.quantization: clip and round uint8; empirical regime

limitations: All previous pilot sources are development-only
Person-to-utterance attribution requires separately verified mappings; not supplied by these ASD labels
No unseen restorer/detector transfer claim from this protocol alone
detector_choice: Use the dataset-specific checkpoint documented by the authors; selected on training-source diagnostics before any calibration/test inference
execution_note: The source split and annotation-only clip selection are unchanged. Historical TalkSet audits are development/transfer diagnostics. They cannot be reused as AVA-checkpoint risk labels.
